classification.difficultyReason: Find the total from the graph, calculate the two quartile frequencies and estimate their horizontal-axis values from the ogive before subtracting.

spec.description: Unfilled adjacent histogram bars with a black ogive, square grid, integer horizontal ticks, axis arrows and a horizontal-axis break before 19. Decorative grey bar fill is omitted.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied histogram and ogive are visible; quartile readings and IQR belong to the editable answer.

answer.worked:
Total frequency: $30$.

$\begin{aligned}Q_1\text{ position}&=0.25\times30=7.5\\Q_3\text{ position}&=0.75\times30=22.5\end{aligned}$

Draw horizontal guides from these frequencies to the ogive and read down to the horizontal axis. To the precision of the graph, $Q_1\approx20.5$ and $Q_3\approx23.5$ plants.

$\begin{aligned}\mathrm{IQR}&=Q_3-Q_1\\&\approx23.5-20.5\\&=3\text{ plants}\end{aligned}$
